title: Daily energy intake in Hall's trial, by diet and week
description: Bar chart of mean daily energy intake, in kilocalories, of 19 inpatients at the NIH Clinical Center over the doubly labeled water measurement periods: on the ultra-processed diet 3,099 in week 1 and 2,865 in week 2; on the unprocessed diet 2,555 in week 1 and 2,486 in week 2. Data: Hall et al. 2019, Table 2.
